name: brackets_tab
_comment: Wave 9 target brackets: fly out from the start stellar (inertialess Kit Ring Crawler: Down stops it), then 30 times: Tab to the next ship, a window shot, and a short turn so escorts re-form and their sprites turn. Read the shots with analysis/brackets.mjs (box size per target, art bbox), the target panel for the class, and the recording for the frames right after each Tab (does the box zoom in?). Pilots w9_esc_a / w9_esc_b (six stock-art escorts each, Kit Range) and w9_sol (Sol traffic).
